description.text: A concept pack released on 13 July 2013 that gathered the best-known cards of the BW series, from tournament favorites to popular Pokémon in new artwork, along with new cards. Reshiram-EX and Zekrom-EX, the symbols of the series on its wrapper, came back from the 2011 Battle Strength Decks, and some illustrations link up across cards. Its Trainers include tie-ins with the TV show Pokémon Smash!. The cards are numbered to 93, followed by gold Reshiram and Zekrom, an Imakuni? Supporter and three Pokémon Enterprise cards. In English it became Legendary Treasures in November 2013, the last English BW set.
